title: Nomadics
summary: On living lightly and moving often: the tools, the vehicles, the books that make a rolling household possible.
body: We have been asked many times about the best way to live on the road. The short answer is: with less. The long answer fills this section — vehicles, stoves, the Whole Earth way of packing a truck. See also SHELTER, page 92.

title: Owner-built homes
body:
A house you build yourself is a house you understand. This book walks through footings, framing and the mistakes everyone makes the first time, with drawings on nearly every page.

Recommended by three readers this year.
